name: TX-03
label: Likely R

key_factors: Strong Republican district lean of R+11
Incumbent Keith Self running with a fundraising edge and outside support
No public general-election polling; prediction markets price Democratic chances near 4%
Challenger Evan Hunt has modest cash on hand
model.rationale: The forecast stays close to the fundamentals: a heavily Republican-leaning district, an incumbent with a clear money advantage, and markets giving the Democrat only about a 4% chance. With no polling to contradict that picture, there is no basis to move the margin materially.
model.watch: A late surge in Democratic spending or polling showing Self under 50% against Hunt would be the first sign of a real contest.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
TX-03 is a solidly Republican Collin County seat, and incumbent Keith Self is seeking a third term after clearing his primary. The district's partisan lean of about eleven points Republican, combined with the usual incumbency advantage, makes Self the clear favorite on paper. He has also out-raised Democratic challenger Evan Hunt and benefits from outside support, while Hunt's campaign has limited cash available.

No public general-election polls cover the race, and no expert raters have flagged it as competitive, so the outlook rests on fundamentals and market pricing, both of which point strongly to Self. A significant national Democratic wave or unexpected candidate-level development would be needed to put this seat in play.
